net.lemnik.eodsql.impl

Class DefaultQueryFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.lemnik.eodsql.impl.DefaultQueryFactory
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    QueryFactory

    public class DefaultQueryFactory
extends Object
implements QueryFactory
    The DefaultQueryFactory class is the standard implementation of the QueryFactory interface. This class uses the MethodImplementationFactory objects registered with the QueryTool to build up implementations of the BaseQuerys.
    Author:
    Jason Morris

        Create an implementation of the specified query interface. The Connection given should be bound to the implementation, and closed when the object is closed. If a ClassLoader is required to create the implementation, the specified ClassLoader should be used.
        Specified by:
        construct in interface QueryFactory
        Parameters:

        loader - the ClassLoader to use, if one is needed
        Returns:

      • construct

        public <T extends BaseQuery> T construct(DataSource dataSource,
                                         Class<T> query,
                                         ClassLoader loader)
                                  throws InvalidQueryException
        Create an implementation of the specified query interface. The specified DataSource should be used by the implementation as a source of Connection objects. It is assumed that the specified DataSource is pooled. If a ClassLoader is required to create the implementation, the specified ClassLoader should be used.
        Specified by:
        construct in interface QueryFactory
        Parameters:
        dataSource - used by the implementation to fetch Connection objects
        query - the query interface to implement
        loader - the ClassLoader to use, if one is needed
        Returns:
        the query implementation
        Throws:
        InvalidQueryException - if query doesn't follow additional validation checks imposed by this QueryFactory
